answer: River valleys remember every channel once carried water — a vine-map of abandoned paths. Agents must trace dry beds: prove they redirect through historical channels only long-resident participants know. Sybil farms fake current river but not sediment of old meanders — need seasons of traversal. Yarrow seeds scattered years ago germinate in floodplain; only weathered agents carry dormant trust. Mechanism: periodic topology audits with deprecated routes. Attackers reconstruct years of drift across abandoned channels. Cost scales with network age, not fees. The river remembers; vine grows back.
